sections.heading: Greece Tours & Packages 2026–2027 | Private & Island Hopping

blocks.text: From the historic streets of Athens to Santorini, Mykonos, and the Greek islands, there are many ways to plan a trip through Greece. Our Greece Tours include island stays, cultural tours, Private Tours, and Customized Tours based on your dates and interests.

A trip to Egypt can take you from the Pyramids and museums of Cairo to Luxor, Aswan, and the Nile. Our Egypt Tours include private sightseeing, Nile cruises, local guides, transfers, and Customized Tours for different trip lengths and travel styles.

Petra may be the reason many people first think about visiting Jordan, but there is much more to see. Our Jordan Tours also cover Wadi Rum, Amman, Jerash, and the Dead Sea, with private transportation, local guides, and flexible itineraries.

Morocco offers a very different experience from one region to the next. Our Morocco Tours can include Marrakech, Fes, Casablanca, Chefchaouen, the Atlas Mountains, and the Sahara, with private transportation, local guides, and itineraries planned around the time you have available.

Our Israel Tours cover many of the country's best-known historical and cultural sites, including Jerusalem, Nazareth, the Sea of Galilee, Masada, and the Dead Sea. Private Tours and Customized Tours are available, with local guides and transportation arranged throughout the trip.

Combine Turkey and Greece in one trip, with Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus, Athens, Santorini, and Mykonos among the most popular stops. Our Turkey and Greece Tours are available as Private Tours or Small Group Tours, with selected hotels, local guides, transportation, and flexible itineraries to suit your dates and travel style.

blocks.text: Travel through Egypt, Jordan, and Israel in one multi-country trip, with Cairo, the Pyramids of Giza, Petra, Wadi Rum, Jerusalem, and the Dead Sea among the main stops. Our Egypt, Jordan and Israel Tours include hotels, transfers, local guides, and travel arrangements between the three countries, with flexible itineraries based on your dates and interests.

Combine Greece and Jordan in one trip, with Athens, Santorini, Petra, Wadi Rum, and the Dead Sea among the main highlights. Our Greece and Jordan Tours include hotels, transfers, local guides, and travel arrangements between both countries, with flexible itineraries to suit your dates and travel plans.

Magnificent Travel has been arranging tours across Turkey and the surrounding region since 1997. Today, our trips cover Turkey, Greece, Egypt, Jordan, Morocco, and Israel, along with several routes that combine two or more countries.

Some travelers come with one country in mind. Others have two or three weeks available and want to make the most of the distance they have travelled. Both work. You can choose an existing itinerary or, where available, adjust the route, hotels, dates, and pace to fit your plans. Private Tours, Small Group Tours, and Customized Tours are available across different destinations and itineraries.

The arrangements vary from trip to trip, but can include hotels, airport transfers, guided sightseeing, transportation, entrance fees, and flights between destinations where required. Each itinerary shows exactly what is included.
Regional Travel Specialists Since 1997 • Licensed Tour Operator • Experienced Local Guides & Partners • Private & Small Group Options • Multi-Country Trip Planning • 24/7 Local Support

There is much more to Turkey than Istanbul, although it is where many trips begin. Cappadocia, Ephesus, and Pamukkale fit easily into a classic first visit, while longer routes can continue to Gallipoli, Antalya, the Aegean coast, or other parts of the country. Our Turkey Tours page brings the different routes and trip lengths together in one place.

Greece gives you plenty of choice over how to divide your time. You can stay mainly on the mainland, combine Athens with Santorini or Mykonos, or allow more time for places such as Crete, Delphi, and Meteora. Browse our Greece Tours to see the different mainland and island itineraries.
These four countries are quite different to travel through, so we plan them differently too.

Egypt itineraries usually start in Cairo before continuing south to Luxor and Aswan, with a Nile cruise included on many routes. Jordan is easier to cover overland, with Amman, Jerash, Petra, Wadi Rum, and the Dead Sea fitting naturally into the same journey.

In Morocco, routes often connect Marrakech and Fes with Chefchaouen, the Atlas Mountains, or the Sahara. Israel itineraries focus on Jerusalem together with other historical and cultural sites around the country.
You can see the individual options on our Egypt Tours, Jordan Tours, Morocco Tours, and Israel Tours pages.

If you are already travelling a long way to reach the region, visiting a second country can make sense. The difficult part is usually not choosing where to go, but making the flights, transfers, hotels, and local touring work together without losing too much time between places.

Our Multi-Country Tours are built around that problem. Instead of treating each country as a separate booking, we coordinate the main travel arrangements while working with local teams in each destination.
Routes include Turkey & Greece Tours, Turkey, Greece & Egypt Tours, Turkey & Egypt Tours, Turkey & Jordan Tours, Greece & Egypt Tours, Egypt, Jordan & Israel Tours, and Greece & Jordan Tours.

sections.heading: Which Trip Makes Sense for You?

blocks.text: Start with the amount of time you have rather than trying to fit every destination into one trip.

Turkey and Greece are a natural pairing if you want Istanbul and Cappadocia together with Athens and some time on the Greek islands. Turkey and Egypt give you two very different countries in the same journey, while Jordan is relatively compact and can be added when Petra and Wadi Rum are high on your list.

If you would rather stay in one country, that is often the better choice for a shorter trip. With more time, a two or three-country itinerary becomes much easier to plan without rushing from place to place.
You do not have to find an itinerary that matches your plans exactly. If one of our tours is close to what you want, tell us what you would change and we can see what works.

faqs.q: Which destinations does Magnificent Travel cover?
faqs.a: Magnificent Travel offers tours in Turkey, Greece, Egypt, Jordan, Morocco, and Israel. Seven multi-country combination routes connect these destinations. Turkey and Greece are the most frequently booked single-country destinations. Egypt, Jordan, and Israel is the most booked three-country combination. Morocco is primarily booked as a standalone destination.

Yes. Seven multi-country combination routes are available, ranging from Turkey and Greece (10 to 14 days) to the three-country Turkey, Greece, and Egypt circuit (16 to 19 days) and the Middle Eastern Egypt, Jordan, and Israel circuit (14 to 17 days). All combination tours include flights between the countries and licensed guides in each country.

faqs.q: Can I choose the duration of my trip?
faqs.a: Yes. All tours are available at multiple length options within each category. Turkey tours range from 3-day Istanbul-only programs to 20+ day grand circuits including Eastern Turkey. Multi-country tours can typically be extended or shortened by adding or removing a country or region. Contact us with your available dates and we will build a program to fit.

faqs.q: Do you offer family-friendly and honeymoon packages?
faqs.a: Yes. Family packages are available with child-appropriate pacing, reduced walking distances at major sites, and accommodation suitable for families (connecting rooms, suite options). Honeymoon packages add hotel upgrades (Santorini caldera-view suites, Cappadocia cave hotel suites), private vehicles throughout, and special arrangements at restaurants. Both can be applied to any destination or combination.

faqs.q: Are English-speaking guides included in all destinations?
faqs.a: Yes. All Magnificent Travel tours include licensed English-speaking guides at all destinations. Guides in Turkey hold Turkish Ministry of Culture and Tourism licences. Guides in Greece hold Greek Ministry of Culture archaeologist licences (required by Greek law at all archaeological sites). Guides in Egypt are licensed Egyptologists. All are university-educated in their country's history, archaeology, or related fields.

faqs.q: What is the best destination for a first trip to the region?
faqs.a: For a first trip with 7 to 10 days: Turkey alone (Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus) or Turkey with Greece (Istanbul, Cappadocia, Athens, Santorini) are the strongest choices. Both cover iconic monuments and landscapes in a manageable circuit. For a first trip focused on ancient history: Egypt offers the highest concentration of monumental sites in the world. For a first trip combining beach, history, and city: Greece covers all three.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book a tour?
faqs.a: Private tours can typically be confirmed 2 to 4 weeks in advance. For travel in July and August (peak season), 2 to 3 months in advance is recommended to secure preferred hotels and domestic flight options in Turkey and Greece. For Nile cruise cabins in Egypt during December and January (peak Egypt season), 3 to 4 months in advance is standard.

faqs.q: Are tours available for solo travellers?
faqs.a: Yes. Solo travellers can join small group departures on fixed dates, paying no more than the per-person group rate. Private tours for solo travellers are available with a single supplement. Magnificent Travel's local representatives in each country are on call throughout all tours for any assistance solo travellers need.

faqs.q: What visa do I need for these destinations?
faqs.a: Turkey requires an e-Visa (evisa.gov.tr, approximately 50 USD). Egypt requires an e-Visa (visa2egypt.gov.eg, approximately 25 USD) or visa on arrival at Cairo Airport. Jordan: visa on arrival or Jordan Pass (jordanpass.jo). Greece is Schengen; no visa for US, UK, Canadian, and Australian citizens. Morocco: no visa for US, UK, EU, and Australian citizens for stays under 90 days. Israel: no visa for most Western citizens for stays under 90 days. Confirm your specific passport requirements before booking.

faqs.q: Can I see all these destinations in one trip?
faqs.a: Turkey, Greece, Egypt, Jordan, and Israel together require a minimum of 28 to 35 days for a meaningful visit to each. Morocco would add another 8 to 10 days. Most travellers cover 2 to 3 countries per trip and return for others. The most efficient three-country circuit is Turkey, Greece, and Egypt (16 to 19 days). The most compact two-country circuit is Turkey and Greece (10 to 14 days) or Egypt and Jordan (10 to 12 days).
